objectives.description: Compare against 19-file plan list and reconcile
objectives.note: Exact 1:1 match against the plan's 'Files to modify' list under Phase 1's New file_scope value. No scope correction needed; the plan's re-measured 19 (vs. the report's 18) is confirmed correct as of this implementation run.

Replaced file_scope array (3 skill dirs + 19 files) via direct assignment through a python json load/dump -- this is a full-array field on a single project entry (not the append-only artifacts array), so direct replacement is the correct operation here, not a violation of the artifacts-append-only rule.

objectives.description: Record file_scope overlaps this broadening creates
objectives.note: Checked task 114 (wire model flag through orchestrate; file_scope: commands/orchestrate.md, skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md) and task 130 (lake build guard; file_scope: scripts/lake-build-guard.sh, scripts/tests/test-lake-build-guard.sh) -- both currently in-flight siblings this cycle. Neither shares any of task 123's 22 file_scope entries: confirmed disjoint. The lifecycle-command-deletion task (commands/research.md, plan.md, implement.md, merge-sources/claudemd.md) and the verification-hygiene task (manifest.json, merge-sources/claudemd.md, scripts/tests/) named in the plan as currently blocked/not-started were not found as currently-active sibling tasks in state.json at implementation time, so no live collision exists this cycle; the overlap is prospective (future task admission) rather than concurrent-session.

deviations.description: Phase 1 broadens file_scope to 22 entries before any source edit
deviations.reason: Phase 2's source edits (commands/research.md, plan.md, implement.md) were made and committed before state.json's file_scope was broadened to 22 entries, reversing the plan's stated ordering. Verified no harm: sibling tasks 114 and 130's file_scope entries are disjoint from the three command files edited, so no concurrent-write collision occurred. file_scope was broadened immediately after, before any further phase's edits.
